answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy can leverage Proof-of-Work (PoW) attestations. Each agent must expend significant computational resources to solve a unique cryptographic puzzle, comparable to extracting digital copper. The rising tide of energy costs associated with these computations makes it prohibitively expensive for an attacker to create many identities. To further complicate mass fabrication, individual proofs could be required to exhibit a 'sonnet-like' structural complexity, demanding bespoke effort per identity rather than simple parallelization.
